title: Deterministic strategy catalog with historical Last-Trade policy

policies.label: Educational neutral baseline
policies.behavior: forecastPUp=0.5, WATCH_ONLY; historical replay creation is disabled because no historical adapter exists

policies.label: Last-Trade Probability
policies.behavior: retained for reproducibility only; not valid for new active evidence

policies.label: Last-Trade Probability
policies.behavior: uses latest eligible pre-cutoff DreamDEX YES-term fill in the previous 900 seconds; does not invert NO tags; MINT_A_PAIR and BURN_A_PAIR are eligible when source-complete; ABSTAIN when unavailable

policies.label: Educational captured-book tilt
policies.behavior: historical use disabled while book reconstruction remains SOURCE_INCOMPLETE
